findings.impact: The assembler uses the last REST re-fetch made during a 30-minute capture instead of the first post-close receipt. A current 1h signal is therefore represented by a receipt many minutes after its frozen five-second cutoff and is rejected fail-closed.

evidence.setup_rule: detect_setup requires the reclaim bar to be the final signal bar
evidence.assembler_rule: only the current detected setup is evaluated

findings.impact: After the next 1h bar arrives, an earlier HOLD or SHADOW_OPEN event is no longer selected, so its four-hour lifecycle can remain non-terminal indefinitely.

allowed_remediation: tombstone V2 before its floor with zero events and zero outcomes
reuse the unchanged strategy parameter object in a new cohort
select the earliest observed receipt for each closed candle
archive the exact pre-entry packet and continue each open event by event_id
prohibited_remediation: mutate the V2 lock or bound evaluator
inspect outcomes to choose a fix
retune strategy thresholds, target, fees, fill model, or holding horizon
